caption: The drawing depicts a brown dog sitting upright on a flat, oval-shaped base. The dog is colored with varying shades of brown, with darker brown used to indicate the fur's texture and shadowed areas. Its head is held high and turned slightly to the right. Around its neck, the dog wears a collar, and it holds a small, rounded basket in its mouth by the handle. The basket contains three small, round objects that appear to be eggs. The background is a plain, unshaded beige color, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Fumagalli," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Statuette of a Dog
